data.body: Phase-4 compatibility decision (2026-09-01): APPROVED/REFINED for Janitor ticketization. Scope now removes all scheduled deprecations; all permanent env/config aliases; every CLI alias, including the entire reconcile family; and all Python/MCP operation aliases. reconcile-check must be decomposed into canonical bridge functionality before its mode, direct-engine route, library/MCP acceptance, bridge-run profile, and report path are deleted: field-diff output fits bridge preview; integrity/orphan diagnostics fit bridge fsck and its live extension point; operational witnesses fit bridge status; a new bridge diagnostic subverb is allowed only for a coherent remainder. Every internal-only shim must have all production, test, dynamic-load, string, and monkeypatch consumers migrated atomically to one canonical owner, then be deleted; current reachability is migration work, not a retention reason. A prerequisite ADR must prohibit future internal-only compatibility shims and merge before implementation children. ADR RESEARCH findings: docs/api-stability already treats underscore paths as private; ADR 0083 already requires one binding/no re-export shim for reconciler moves because old-path patching is unsound; ADR 0016, ADR 0092, and architecture.md record contrary retained shims that must be explicitly superseded/narrowed; public facades plus MCP/event/wire/data compatibility remain distinct. MCP re-export clarification: 21 model classes moved from rebar.mcp_server to private rebar._mcp_models; mcp_server only re-imports them for historical Python imports. Removing those names does not change MCP tools, schemas, outputSchema, or payloads. Full decision, symbol map, and ADR research are in .joe-janitor/report-2026-08-29.md.
